protocol.B0: Pinned native selector, rerank disabled, saved original candidate ordering
protocol.B1: Pinned native selector and native rerank adapter, saved provider scores replayed
protocol.B2: Saved complete-pool custom whole-query ordering, native selection
protocol.B3: Saved conditional composite fusion ordering, native selection

limitations: Reuses historical development/validation cases: not a new independent benchmark.
Uses recorded provider scores, not new provider responses or paid cold latency.
Unjudged chunks do not count as irrelevant; nDCG and noise ratio are null when labels are incomplete.
Recall denominator includes annotated-positive chunks only; cannot infer exhaustive relevance.
B1/B2 may be equivalent: the pinned upstream already reranks before top-k/token truncation.
